description: Defines structures and functions for calculating Shared Channel (SCH) parameters related to LDPC coding, including CRC size, number of codeblocks, lifting size, and codeblock size, based on transport block size and base graph type.

classes.name: sch_information
classes.description: Holds parameters for Shared Channel segmentation derived from transport block size and code rate.

methods.name: get_sch_segmentation_info
methods.description: Calculates SCH parameters based on transport block size and target code rate.

methods.name: compute_tb_crc_size
methods.description: Computes CRC size for a given transport block size.

methods.name: compute_nof_codeblocks
methods.description: Calculates number of codeblocks for a given transport block size and base graph.

methods.name: compute_lifting_size
methods.description: Determines the lifting size based on transport block size, base graph, and number of segments.

methods.name: compute_codeblock_size
methods.description: Calculates codeblock size for specified base graph and lifting size.
